notes: 修 0.3.0 的语言判定：DSH 在设置里切换界面语言时改的是页面 html lang，不改 navigator.language，导致面板没跟着变。现在按 html lang 优先、系统语言兜底，并且每次渲染现读，切语言后不重启也生效
notesEn: Fixes the 0.3.0 language detection: when DSH switches its UI language it updates the page's html lang, not navigator.language, so the panel stayed Chinese. Now it reads html lang first with the system locale as fallback, on every render, so switching the language takes effect without a restart
